title: Modules on a scheme: colimits exist, and a coproduct is the directed colimit of its finite subcoproducts
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. (1) Every small diagram in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ has a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; in particular every family of $\mathcal O_X$-modules indexed by a set has a coproduct. (2) Let $A$ be a set and $(\mathcal G_a)_{a\in A}$ a family of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. For every subset $A'\subseteq A$ let $(C_{A'},(\iota^{A'}_a)_{a\in A'})$ be a coproduct of $(\mathcal G_a)_{a\in A'}$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, and for $A'\subseteq A''\subseteq A$ let $\kappa_{A''A'}:C_{A'}\to C_{A''}$ be the unique morphism with $\kappa_{A''A'}\circ\iota^{A'}_a=\iota^{A''}_a$ for all $a\in A'$; write $C=C_A$ and $\kappa_{A'}=\kappa_{AA'}$. Then the finite subsets of $A$, ordered by inclusion, form a directed set (nonempty, any two have a common upper bound), $(C_{A'},\kappa_{A''A'})$ is a system over it ($\kappa_{A'A'}=\mathrm{id}$, $\kappa_{A'''A''}\kappa_{A''A'}=\kappa_{A'''A'}$), and $(C,(\kappa_{A'})_{A'\text{ finite}})$ is a colimit of this system in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$.
